urls.rationale: Public officers - ethics definitions (effective until 1/1/2018) - definitional support cross-referenced from lobbying chapters.
Financial disclosure statement filed with ethics commission - disclosure regime that intersects with lobbying disclosure.
Former state officials to report certain financial information - post-employment disclosure tied to lobbying restrictions.
Certain financial information substituted in statements of local officials and college/university trustees.
Representation by present or former public official or employee prohibited - revolving-door restriction directly relevant to lobbying.
Conflicts of interest of member of general assembly - cross-referenced from legislative-agent regime.
No compensation to elected or appointed state official other than from agency served - constrains lobbying-adjacent payments.
Ohio ethics commission created - administering body referenced by lobbying-disclosure provisions.
Powers and duties of ethics commission.
No divulging of information in disclosure statements - confidentiality of disclosure filings.
Recommending legislation - advisory opinions issued by ethics commission.
Furnishing financial disclosure form to candidates.

notes: Chapter 102 is support material - definitions, ethics commission framework, financial-disclosure requirements, and revolving-door restrictions cross-referenced by the Ch. 101/121 lobbying regimes. The second 102.01 variant (effective 1/1/2018) is the future-text duplicate and not selected for the 2015 vintage.
